name: Bicycle

comps.spec: Roller chain, 1/2 in pitch, with chainrings, rear sprockets and derailleurs — the drive for pedal generators
Reed switch speed sensor with a spoke magnet (bike computers)
comps.loc: On the fork, magnet on a spoke

comps.spec: Hub dynamo, 6V 3W, or bottle dynamo (city and touring bikes)
comps.loc: Front hub or clamped to the fork

comps.spec: Steel brake and gear cables, about 1.1–1.6 mm, with housings
Hub, bottom bracket and headset bearings; wheels with tyres
Inner tubes and tyres — strong rubber straps and patches
Battery or USB LED front and rear lights

comps.loc: On the frame or in the garage

comps.spec: Coin cell in the bike computer
Suspension fork on mountain bikes (Trek Marlin 5: coil spring, 80–100 mm travel; Schwinn Mesa 2: 63 mm travel); better forks hold air or nitrogen under pressure — leave them whole

notes: Working bikes get ridden away; broken ones in sheds, bike racks and recycling yards still give chains, cables, bearings and dynamos.

sources.title: Open Repair Alliance, Open Repair Data v0.3 (community repair events, 2012 to July 2026; CC BY-SA 4.0): 18,162 repairs recorded as Unpowered - Bicycle
